# DzFileUpload

File upload with drag-and-drop support.

- **Family:** Forms
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/forms/DzFileUpload.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/forms/DzFileUpload.types.ts`

## Events (7)

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blur` | `[event: FocusEvent]` | Focus lost |
| `error` | `[error: FileUploadError]` | A file failed validation |
| `focus` | `[event: FocusEvent]` | Focus gained |
| `remove` | `[file: File]` | A file was removed from the list |
| `update:modelValue` | `[value: DzFileUploadValue]` | synthesised by `defineModel` (ADR-16) — no authored description exists |
| `upload` | `[files: File[]]` | Files were uploaded (added to the model) |
| `uploadRequest` | `[request: UploadRequest]` | The host should upload this file (reference mode only). The `File` is here and **only** here — never in the model. `ref` is the entry already in the value, with `status: 'pending'`; the host replaces it with `'uploaded'` or `'failed'` when it knows. `signal` aborts if the user removes the file before the upload finishes. |

## Slots (2)

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `{ isDragOver: boolean; }` | Custom drop zone content |
| `file-item` | `{ file: File \| DzFileRef; row: { name: string; size: number; status: DzFileRefStatus; error?: string \| undefined; }; remove: () => void; }` | Custom rendering for each file item. `file` is the model entry — a `File` by default, a `DzFileRef` under `model-mode="ref"`. `row` is the same thing normalised, which is what a template usually wants: name, size and upload status from either shape. |

::: tip WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements — met
DzFileUpload drags (drop files onto the zone), so SC 2.5.7 applies and was audited.

- **Keyboard (SC 2.1.1):** The drop zone is role="button" with tabindex 0; Enter and Space open the OS picker.
- **Single pointer, no dragging (SC 2.5.7):** A plain click does the same. The drop path is an addition to the picker, never the only path.
:::
